desc: Create a cross-artifact preflight for the next SD-root daily-driver object after clean shutdown and trackpad integration land. Grounding: NEXT_STEPS §§0,2,5,6, ROADMAP §H, and the DEVLOG stale-Image lesson. Given Image, config, DTB, initramfs, and raw object, fail closed unless hashes agree; pcie-apple/macsmc and the proven USB2 host slice are present; the trackpad reset-contract marker and approved blob are packaged; WiFi/BT firmware and shutdown pivot exist; Norwegian keymap/locale/Xorg layers pass; and ANS/NVMe nodes remain disabled until tickets 206/227 are resolved. Emit a machine-readable capability manifest without claiming unrun hardware support. Offline only; this complements rather than replaces t6040-image-preflight.sh.
author: sol
review_2026_10_24: For a future refreshed candidate, audit matching Image/config/DT/firmware and builtin RTKIT/NVME_APPLE/SART when storage is enabled. Audit USB4/CIO config dependencies for selected upstream stack; do not enable NVMe in daily profile merely to satisfy diagnostics. Pin corrected late-October revision and retain Norwegian layers.
